 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. India have a golden chance to wrap up the five-match T20I series against New Zealand as they arrive in Wellington for the third game with a 2-0 lead.
 The visitors have made it look comfortable so far, and the conditions in the capital could make it easier still.

 Both matches in Christchurch ended with India chasing under the lights, and the dew and the 8pm start times made batting second a lot easier. New Zealand's sloppy fielding then handed India much of what the conditions hadn't already given them.
 The hosts have reached Wellington in a weaker position as well, since Matt Henry has been rested for the remaining games and Lockie Ferguson will sit this one out.
 With both of those bowlers missing, the Blackcaps' seam attack looks short of experience and firepower. Their pacers have picked up only four wickets across the series so far, which shows how little pressure they've put on India's batters.
